implementation: Cisco 4400 Series Wireless LAN Controller (Quicksec Algorithms)
description: The Cisco 4400 Series Wireless LAN Controllers provide centralized control and scalability for medium to large-scale Government and Enterprise wireless LAN networks and support the IEEE 802.11i wireless security standard in conjunction with meeting the Wi-Fi Alliances interoperability specification WPA2 to enable a Secure Wireless Architecture. The Cisco WLAN Controllers support voice, video and data services, location & asset tracking, integrated intrusion detection & intrusion protection and intelligent radio resource management and comply with the commercial wireless security policies issued by the U.S. Federal Government and the Department of Defense (DoD).
